editorial_checks: Two full real-case essays with independently written English and complete Chinese scripts. No invented participants, scenes, transaction losses or private thoughts. SAE remains background language rather than front-end labels.

The Google essay distinguishes publisher ad servers, exchanges and advertiser buying tools. Last Look concerns historical bid ordering and the highest outside exchange bid, not every current auction or direct control of each advertiser's maximum bid.

The 2025 district-court findings after trial are distinguished from mere allegations, from the dismissed advertiser-ad-network claim, from a blanket judgment about all acquisitions, and from the separate Google Search case.
Google's integration and separation-cost arguments are retained and attributed. Useful real-time demand is distinguished from the challenged preferential ordering within a larger useful function.

The 2026 remedies opinion's rejection of structural relief, selection of interoperability and data access, and six-year oversight design are not treated as completed implementation, final resolution of subsequent proceedings or measured gains in publisher income. The September announcement is not every provision's effective date.

The Thames essay concerns household customers; the existence of separate non-household retail arrangements is not erased. Network investment and legitimate returns remain part of the problem rather than presumed misconduct.

P30's commencement and principles are distinguished from a ban on dividends. October 2023 cash dividends, March 2024 pension-related transfers and the tax-loss arrangement are not collapsed. The £131.3 million arrangement had no net cash outflow; the regulator's concern was loss of usable value without a net benefit.
Wastewater and dividend penalties, transfer values and price-control adjustments remain distinct. The future tax-related protection is not represented as an immediate household refund.

Final regulatory findings, the company's response and the separate Environment Agency investigation are differentiated. Wastewater enforcement does not establish every discharge's cause or a finding of unsafe drinking water for all households.

The August 2025 payment plan is a set of obligations, not a verified payment receipt. The remaining balance is due on the earliest trigger; 2030 is a backstop, not an unconditional deferral. Accountability is distinguished from capacity to finance repairs and statutory service.

The Ofwat case explanations and announcements were substantively readable through indexed official text despite direct-access 403 responses. Its detailed final-decision PDFs were not represented as exhaustively read. The Google liability PDF was downloaded and relevant passages checked, including a rendered page on Last Look.

Earlier prose and data remain unchanged. Article dates are now taken from individual records and old update cards retain their own dates; the expanded landing keeps its original first-publication date. No new library category or new image assets.
